defect: The added outAddr validity check returns SCE_KERNEL_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDR for a null output address, which is a valid way to skip decoded data (the callee already handles outbuf == NULL).
reason: The fix removes exactly this added early return; _AtracDecodeData already had an out != NULL path, so the change broke a valid call pattern.

defect: PSPStickDragDrop::SetSpacing stores s/3 but GetSpacing returns the stored value unscaled, so each resize gesture (start = GetSpacing, then SetSpacing) shrinks the stick head by a factor of 3.
reason: Both accessors were added by this change and the fix makes GetSpacing return spacing_ * 3 to restore the symmetry.

defect: Operator precedence error in the added 'confirmed = confirmed && IsKeyPressed(Enter) || IsKeyPressed(KeypadEnter)', which treats any keypad-Enter press as a confirmation regardless of the InputText result.
reason: The fix adds the missing parentheses to this line added by the change; the fix's other hunk (the %f printf) touches a pre-existing line.

defect: Removing the flip special cases changed the framebuffer orientation convention, but BlitFramebuffer kept the old flipped Y coordinates for glBlitFramebuffer and its draw path now passes unflipped v coordinates, so blits come out wrong.
reason: The one-day-later follow-up 'Fix a few more flips' repairs the BlitFramebuffer coordinates and the DrawActiveTexture call this change modified; the breakage arose only from this change's convention switch.

defect: The added GetBlockProfileStats default stub silently returns empty stats, and IRBlockCache (which this commit makes report SupportsProfiling under IR_PROFILING) never overrides it, so IR profiling always shows zero executions and time.
reason: The fix turns the stub into a pure virtual and adds the missing IRBlockCache and IRNativeBlockCacheDebugInterface implementations; the defect is latent in a developer-only IR_PROFILING build but comes from this commit.

defect: UTF8toSJIS and UTF16toSJIS check jis2ucsTable although they read ucs2jisTable, and UTF16toUTF8 needlessly requires a table, so a missing ucs2jis table is dereferenced and valid UTF16-to-UTF8 calls fail.
reason: All three wrong table checks were added by this change and the fix corrects exactly them.

defect: The newly enabled CreateDownloadTempBuffer creates the readback framebuffer with nvfb->width instead of nvfb->bufferWidth, so it can be too small for the readback copy.
reason: The CreateFramebuffer line was introduced (uncommented) by this change and the fix only replaces width with bufferWidth there; seeing that readback uses bufferWidth needs the common framebuffer code.

defect: The added PAKFILE2.BIN bypass writes 'bootpath == ...' (a comparison) instead of an assignment, so the alternate boot file is never selected.
reason: The fix changes == to = on this added line; the typo is visible in the diff.

defect: UpdateRunLoop is declared as taking a GraphicsContext * although the parameter is the InputState, mismatching its definition.
reason: The changed declaration has the wrong parameter type and the next-day fix corrects it to InputState *.

defect: The macOS branch tests PPSSPP_PLATFORM(MACOS), but ppsspp_config.h only defines PPSSPP_PLATFORM_MAC, so on macOS no machine context is defined and MACHINE_CONTEXT_SUPPORTED is never set.
reason: The fix renames the macro to MAC on the line this change wrote; recognising the wrong name needs ppsspp_config.h.

defect: The added SetError switches PointerWrap to MODE_MEASURE for any error including ERROR_WARNING, so a version-mismatch warning silently aborts savestate loading.
reason: The fix changes the condition to error > ERROR_WARNING in the SetError added by this change; the warning callers come from the same commit.

defect: The added DEBUG_LOG in sceFontGetFontInfoByIndexNumber has four format specifiers ('%x, %x, %i, %i') but only three arguments, which is undefined behaviour in the varargs log call.
reason: The fix rewrites this log line to three specifiers; the rest of the fix (sceFontGetFontList error codes) concerns pre-existing code.

defect: The fix makes the projection and shade-map UV modes also apply uScale/vScale times the vertex rescale factor in u_uvscaleoffset.
reason: Before this change those modes applied no UV scale at all, and later code (628bf49) went back to the width/height factor only for them, so the widthFactor-only branch was not a regression introduced here.

defect: For ATRAC3+ the constructor sets codecOpen_ = true unconditionally after atrac3p_alloc, which returns nullptr on bad block_align or channels, so Decode calls atrac3p_decode_frame with a null context and crashes instead of failing as the avcodec_open2 path did.
reason: The fix makes Decode return false when the codec failed to open; the crash path for a failed AT3+ init was introduced by this change (later commits only extended it to AT3).

defect: The new line comparator does not strip carriage returns, so expected files with CRLF line endings never match the emulator output and headless tests fail spuriously.
reason: The comparison code was added by this change and the fix adds TrimNewlines to its Fill(); the CRLF expectation files lie outside the diff.

defect: The added bound check uses sizeof(f) / sizeof(s8) = 10 instead of the 5 rows of f, so predict_nr values 5 to 9 still index past the coefficient table.
reason: The fix corrects this added check to sizeof(f[0]); the wrong divisor is visible in the diff.

defect: Changing the color-test rounding offset from 0.5/255 to 0.49/255 in roundTo255thv breaks color-test comparisons and causes a black box in Super Robot Taisen Z.
reason: The fix reverts exactly the color-test half of this change; the regression only shows on game content.

defect: sceSasSetVoice and sceSasSetVoicePCM invert the loop argument (loop ? false : true), so non-looping voices loop and looping voices do not.
reason: The fix restores the direct mapping on both lines this change inverted, after repairing the real VAG loop bugs in SasAudio.

defect: The added GL version parsing strcpy's the GL_VERSION string into a 64-byte stack buffer with no length or null check, which can overflow or crash.
reason: The fix replaces the strcpy with a guarded strncpy into a zeroed buffer on the lines this change added.

defect: textureShaderInfo.clear() was moved after the scan loop, discarding every texture shader just loaded and leaving only 'Off'.
reason: The fix moves the clear back before the scan and inserts 'Off' at the front; the misplaced clear is visible in the diff.

defect: AddOtherChoice appends to otherChoices_ on every CreateViews without clearing, so after views are recreated update() calls SetVisibility on deleted views (crash), and update() calls the heavy GetSaveDataDirectories every frame (lag).
reason: Both problems come from lines added by this change, and the fix clears otherChoices_ and caches saveDirs in CreateViews.

defect: OnPointClick now sends NKCODE_PERIOD with KEY_CHAR, but with KEY_CHAR the key code is taken as a character, so the '.' button inserts a different character.
reason: The fix reverts this changed line to (InputKeyCode)'.'; seeing that NKCODE_PERIOD is not the ASCII '.' needs the key code definitions.

defect: In UpdateViewportAndProjection the Y offset and viewport height are scaled by renderWidthFactor_ instead of renderHeightFactor_.
reason: This change swapped renderHeightFactor_ for renderWidthFactor_ on these lines and the fix swaps them back, although the code sat after an early return and was latent at the time.

defect: gpuCommandsAtCallLevel is incremented by 'executed', which is already doubled into CPU cycles, so the per-call-level command counts are twice the real number.
reason: The fix makes executed the command count and doubles it only for the cycle counters; the error is in lines added by this change.

defect: The STRIP_PSP check tests startsWith(path, '/PSP') right after the leading '/' was erased, so it never matches; DirectoryFileHandle::fileSystemFlags_ is also never set.
reason: The fix changes the prefix to 'PSP/' and sets the handle flags; the dead check is visible in the added lines.

defect: The new software alpha blending path is applied even in clear mode, where the rasterizer should write the clear color directly.
reason: Among its feature additions the fix adds && !gstate.isModeClear() to the blending condition this change added; knowing that clear mode bypasses blending needs GE semantics outside the diff.

defect: RotateUVs disables the first condition (v0.x > v2.x && v0.y < v2.y), which is correct in through mode, so rectangles with that orientation stop getting their UVs rotated.
reason: The fix restores that condition for through mode next to the one this change enabled and adds a separate rule for non-through mode, so this change's swap was a partial regression.

defect: The fake sceFontGetCharGlyphImage memsets bytesPerLine*bufHeight*pixelFormat bytes, overrunning the glyph buffer by multiplying a byte count by the pixel format enum.
reason: The fix drops the *pixelFormat on this added line.

defect: GetSamplingParams dereferences entry (CacheKey, fullhash) whenever the replacer is enabled, but GetFramebufferSamplingParams in the same change passes nullptr, causing a crash.
reason: The fix adds the null checks to the lines this change added; the nullptr caller is in the diff.

defect: The new QuickTexHash rounds 4-bit and DXT formats up to one byte per pixel and computes a negative pad when w > bufw, so it hashes the wrong memory and misses texture changes (wrong textures).
reason: The fix reverts QuickTexHash to hashing the whole buffer as before; the hashing errors are in code this change added.

defect: The log console is opened with hideLog before the command line is parsed, so the -l option no longer shows the log window.
reason: The fix moves the LogManager initialisation after argument parsing, undoing the reordering this change made.

defect: ProcessInput uses std::map operator[] on SDLJoyAxisMap and SDLJoyButtonMap, so unmapped axes and buttons insert and return 0 and are reported as axis X or key code 0.
reason: The file is new in this change and the fix replaces operator[] with find(); that the maps are std::map with 0 meaning the X axis is in the header.

defect: The framebuffer vertex preview uses glViewport(x, -y, ...) and an ortho projection sized to the window content (fw, fh) instead of the framebuffer texture size, so the overlay is misplaced when the sizes differ.
reason: The fix corrects both on lines this change added ('just happened to work'); the right dimensions depend on SimpleGLWindow.

defect: The added SubmitPending before acquire also ends and submits presentCmd when a second backbuffer render step occurs in a frame, after which vkBeginCommandBuffer is called on a pending command buffer and crashes.
reason: The fix stops Pending submits from submitting presentCmd and reuses it instead of re-beginning it; this needs FrameData::SubmitPending from another file.

defect: ImageView::Draw now calls dc.Begin(), which rebinds the UI pipeline and samplers in the middle of drawing and breaks the main screen icon.
reason: The fix removes exactly this added call; its effect depends on UIContext::Begin.

defect: The new template type is named Rect, which collides with the Rect type from Apple system headers and breaks the iOS build.
reason: The fix renames it to DisplayRect; the collision is with a platform header outside the repository.

defect: The Qt paths discard the result of convertToFormat, so the manual ARGB-to-RGBA loop runs on an unconverted image (and pngLoadPtr never converts at all), and the RGBA8888 branch is enabled for Qt 5.0 and 5.1 where that format does not exist.
reason: The fix assigns the converted image, adds the missing conversion, sizes the buffer as width*height*4 and moves the version check to Qt 5.2, all in lines this change added.

defect: hleEnterVblank calls __KernelSwitchOffThread unconditionally, rescheduling threads on vblank even when interrupts are disabled.
reason: The fix replaces the added call with PSP_INTR_ALWAYS_RESCHED, which respects ONLY_IF_ENABLED; the interrupts-disabled semantics live in the kernel code.

defect: The rewritten check calls gpu->PresentedThisFrame() without the gpu null check the old condition had, crashing when gpu is null (loading a ppdmp while another one displays).
reason: The change dropped the 'gpu &&' guard and the fix restores it on that line.

defect: The added null-shader early return in CreateGraphicsPipeline leaks the newly allocated pipeline and returns false from a pointer-returning function.
reason: The fix deletes the pipeline and returns NULL on that added path.
